correctness.rationale: Original proof of the local normal form incorrectly asserted x=1−|t|^p/p+O(|t|^{min(2p,p+2)}), omitting the cos(t) contribution −t²/2; this stated estimate is false for 1<p<2. A complete corrected RESULT.md gives x=1−|t|^p/p+O_p(t²), y=t+O_p(|t|^{p+1}); since t²=o(|t|^p), the required tangent normal form and half-variance cell coefficient q_p remain valid. Independently reconstructed arc-minus-chord difference via tangent variation; away from axis it is bounded by C h³d^{2p−4}, and q_p tails behave as (p−1)²j^{2p−4}/24. These estimates yield the three residue-lattice phases below 3/2. At p=3/2 curvature density is (4d)^−1, eight axis sides giving h²ln n/12; for p>3/2 density is integrable and the smooth-cell Riemann sum yields (h²/24)∫ det²/|γʹ|³. Verified circle p=2 identity 2π−2n sin(π/n) and coefficient π/12. Reassessed C on the complete new final claim/proof, not the false original intermediate assertion.

final_claim: For zero-phase, angular-grid polygons of the Euclidean planar ell_p disk, perimeter loss has a three-phase lattice sum for 1<p<3/2, a sharp h² log n coefficient 1/12 at p=3/2, and an integrable curvature density h² coefficient for p>3/2. The corrected local normal form includes its omitted O(t²) term.
limitations: Each p>1 fixed and only zero-phase angular sampling; numerical checks cannot prove uniformity in n, p or other sampling rules.
